title: fix(app-shell,i18n): a page route's breadcrumb drops the Pages crumb, and a caller without manage_metadata sees no Studio entry on a page (objectui#12198)
body:
Fixes #12198

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Executes the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/cloud#2768 (comment 6118501670): a user page shows no 「Pages」 crumb, and a caller who may not author metadata sees no Studio handle on it. Implemented by the `domain:ui` seat 2 dev run, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01G5TSaEwbEQsKMjhzTB4rEd`.

## What changed

- **The crumb.** On `/apps/APP/page/NAME` the top bar's trail went app › Pages › page (on the cloud home, Cloud › Pages › Home). The Pages crumb named a metadata type and linked only to the app's base, which the app pill already opens. `AppHeader`'s `routeType === 'page'` branch of `extraSegments` no longer pushes it; the trail goes from the app pill straight to the page. Dashboard, report, system and object routes are untouched.
- **The key.** `console.breadcrumb.pages` had exactly one reader, that push (measured with `git grep`; control: `console.breadcrumb.marketplace` answers 8 hits on the same tree). It is retired from all ten packs (`en`, `zh`, `ja`, `ko`, `de`, `fr`, `es`, `pt`, `ru`, `ar`). The packs are published, so this narrows `@object-ui/i18n`'s published surface: the changeset declares `@object-ui/i18n` `minor` with a BREAKING note naming the key and saying it has no replacement, and `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`.
- **The pins.** New `AppHeader.pageRouteNoAuthoringHandles-12198.test.tsx` renders the real `AppHeader` (with the real `AppSwitcher`, its menu content passed through) and the real `PageView`, each under the real `MePermissionsProvider` seeded with one `/me/permissions` payload. It pins, keyed on the capability and not on a role name:
  - the page route's crumbs after the pill are exactly the page (`['Welcome']`);
  - an organization owner (workspace admin, framework `organization_admin` set: `manage_org_users`, `setup.access`, `setup.write`, no `manage_metadata`) sees none of the page pencil (`page-edit-in-studio-button`), the 「Edit app」 button (`app-design-in-studio-button`) or the pill's Studio row (`app-switcher-edit-in-studio`);
  - a plain member (no admin flag, `systemPermissions: []`, the framework `member_default` baseline) sees none of the three;
  - CONTROL: a workspace admin holding `manage_metadata` sees all three, and the row and the button carry one target.
- `AppHeader.appIdentity-12201.test.tsx` pinned the old trail ("two crumbs, Pages and Welcome"); its separator count now reads one crumb. No other assertion changed.

## Proof the pins can fail (each mutation landed through `ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven by blob hash == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`)

- Planting the Pages push back into `AppHeader`: 2 failed / 11 passed across the new pin and the 12201 file; the new crumb case received `["console.breadcrumb.pages", "Welcome"]`.
- Dropping `canAuthorMetadata` from both gates (`canDesignInStudio`, `canEditInStudio`): the organization-owner case fails with all three entries present (both hrefs `/studio/com.objectstack.cloud/interfaces?surface=page:welcome`, pencil present); the member and control cases stay green, as expected (the member is not an admin).
- On a tree merging objectui#12239 (the `useHref('/')` change to `PageView`), the pin's `react-router-dom` mock carries `useHref`; with that line deleted, 3 of 4 cases fail with the vitest "No useHref export is defined" error. objectui#12239 has since landed and is merged into this branch; the final run below includes it.

## Acceptance notes

- **Fail-open path (reported, doctrine not changed here).** Measured with the same harness: when `/me/permissions` omits `systemPermissions`, a workspace admin (an organization owner included) sees all three Studio entries, because `hasCapabilities` treats an absent array as unknown and fails open. Server-side producers of that shape, in framework `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints.ts`, the `/auth/me/permissions` handler: the deliberate degraded branch when no SecurityPlugin or metadata service is wired (the server is open there too), and the handler's outer `catch`, which answers `authenticated`, `userId`, `objects` and `fields` only, after any throw in the handler. The second one is the path where a hosted owner would see the handles while the server still refuses the write; the repo that would carry a change is objectstack (framework). The cloud control plane's own endpoint was not read from this session.
- **The dashboard and report crumbs are the same class, not changed here.** On `/apps/APP/dashboard/NAME` the trail is the `console.breadcrumb.dashboards` type crumb, linked to the app's base, then the dashboard (probe on this harness: `["console.breadcrumb.dashboards", "Ops Board"]`). The report branch pushes `console.breadcrumb.reports` the same way (read from the code, not probed). The ruling on cloud#2768 named the Pages crumb only.
- **Harness note.** With `AppHeader` and `PageView` mounted in one tree, this harness's render never finished (the vitest worker died at the cap); mounted one after the other under the same payload they render normally. The cause, somewhere among the stubs, was not traced; the console's own tree is not this harness.
- `check:eager-locale-catalogues` needs a built console bundle and answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET locally: NOT MEASURED here, left to CI.

## Gates (local, all at `b65554b6`)

- Build of the `@object-ui/app-shell` dependency closure (turbo, 28/28 tasks): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`: exit 0 (both `Done`; app-shell's `tsconfig.test.json` lists the new test file).
- `pnpm exec vitest run` over `packages/app-shell/src/layout/`, the six `PageView` test files and `packages/i18n/`: 152 files passed, 1800 tests passed, 13 skipped. Narrowed on purpose; the whole suite is CI's.
- `eslint .` in `packages/app-shell` (1841 files, 0 errors) and `packages/i18n` (115 files, 0 errors), from `--format json`; type-aware linting is not enabled in `eslint.config.js`, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`: all exit 0.
